long_biography.plain_text:
Post-communist economic change gave David Beran an opening to begin business in the early 1990s. He first imported office technology, then invested the proceeds in shares and participated in acquisitions connected with Czech privatisation. By the decade's end, he had shifted his attention towards consumer finance and established the lending operations that became Profireal Group.

Beran retained ownership while building a holding structure above country-level lenders. That separation allowed local teams to run credit businesses under the PROFI CREDIT brand while the parent group directed capital and expansion. Its portfolio now combines consumer and business lending with investment projects in financial technology, data, online commerce and renewable energy. Beran chairs the group and concentrates on long-term strategy alongside a professional management team.

uncertainties.detail: David Beran is a common name. The Czech nationality, Czech residence and stored age resolve this record to the Profireal founder born on 26 September 1967. Results for David R. Beran, an older American Altria executive and Richmond Ballet trustee, a chef named Dave Beran, a Czech semiconductor executive and several small-company directors are namesakes and were excluded.

Beran is documented as Profireal's founder and controlling owner and currently chairs its board. Country-level lending and routine group management are handled by other executives, so their roles are not attributed to him; his own operating contribution is described as strategic direction and retained founder control.

Forbes explicitly classifies Beran as self-made, and Profireal traces the core business to his own trading, investment and company-building activity. No inheritance of the principal asset is documented. Public sources do not describe his family starting platform sufficiently to choose the independent-start or advantaged-start subtype, so the broader Self-made label is retained.

Profireal sources have described Beran as both complete owner and majority shareholder at different dates. The dossier uses controlling or majority ownership in published prose and treats historical percentages as time-specific rather than permanently current.

No identity-verified personal LinkedIn, Instagram, Personal Website, Facebook, X, YouTube or TikTok profile was found. The obvious LinkedIn vanity URL belongs to a technology-sector namesake and is rejected. Profireal's official founder page meets the Company Website threshold.

Politics, controversies, allegations, legal matters, sanctions, private-family trivia and vessel-specific research are excluded. Current company values and rich-list estimates are not treated as liquid personal wealth.
